title: Cell / Residency / Multi-Region Topology Manifest Contract
purpose: Defines the first atomic manifest surface that binds a service/tenant fixture to ADR-0009 cell tier, ADR-0049 residency class, ADR-0158 region disposition, ADR-0161 canonical storage class, and quarterly ADR-0009 isolation evidence handles. This is a manifest/spec/cloud-ci gate slice only; it does not implement runtime cell routing, storage provisioning, migration, or evidence collection.

authority.merge_authority: protected oya-ci-required context produced by cloud-ci Rust gate apps per ADR-0515
authority.proposed_adr_scope: ADR-0009 and ADR-0049 are planning/context inputs for this spec-only manifest contract and authorize no runtime product/cloud mutation; accepted ADR-0158 and ADR-0161 provide the binding current manifest/storage-class surfaces for this slice.
authority.deprecated_surface_guardrail: No retired local command surface is introduced or promoted as merge authority. Local command output, if any, is provenance only.

cell_tier_sources.dedicated: ADR-0009 Dedicated: one tenant per cell
cell_tier_sources.shared-small: ADR-0009 Shared-small: up to approximately 10 tenants
cell_tier_sources.shared-medium: ADR-0009 Shared-medium: up to approximately 100 tenants
cell_tier_sources.shared-large: ADR-0009 Shared-large: up to approximately 1000 tenants
cell_tier_sources.agent-runtime: ADR-0009 agent invocation cells: agent execution cells with per-run worktree isolation
cell_tier_sources.public-corpus: ADR-0009 Public-corpus: search public-web ingestion only

residency_class_sources.strict_kr: ADR-0049 StrictKr: all data, replicas, backups, and derived data stay in KR cells
residency_class_sources.kr_with_us_failover: ADR-0049 KrWithUsFailover: primary in KR with opt-in US warm replica for permitted classes
residency_class_sources.per_pack: ADR-0049 PerPack: pack-specific region allow/deny overlay

region_disposition_sources.active_active: ADR-0158: multiple write-able regions with a declared convergence model
region_disposition_sources.active_passive: ADR-0158: primary region plus warm standby and declared RPO/RTO
region_disposition_sources.single_region: ADR-0158: one region; no cross-region presence

storage_class_source: ADR-0161 canonical StorageClass naming scheme oya-<kind>-<tier>.

quarterly_isolation_evidence_sources.network: ADR-0009 network isolation evidence: VPC, security group, and mesh policies prove no cross-cell ingress or egress beyond declared contracts
quarterly_isolation_evidence_sources.storage: ADR-0009 storage isolation evidence: RLS coverage and per-cell Citus shard residency proof
quarterly_isolation_evidence_sources.crypto: ADR-0009 crypto isolation evidence: per-cell HSM partition audit and DEK shred test
quarterly_isolation_evidence_sources.compute: ADR-0009 compute isolation evidence: scheduler quotas and noisy-neighbor p99 bound test
quarterly_isolation_evidence_sources.audit: ADR-0009 audit isolation evidence: chain shard verification

path_conflicts.non_parallel_notes: Serialize with other specs/, root-hub, governance registry, and generated-face work. This slice does not hand-edit generated faces.

non_claims: no runtime cell router or mesh policy enforcement
no Kubernetes StorageClass provisioning or CSI driver invocation
no tenant migration, autosharding, auto-rebalance, or failover execution
no live evidence collection backend; evidence:// references are contract handles only
no provider API, Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, database, KMS, or storage API calls
